name: Cryo-fluorescence / cryo-CLEM imaging of plunge-frozen (vitrified) specimens kept below the devitrification temperature
plain_name: Examine a frozen sample under the microscope while keeping it frozen

sources.citation: Last, M. G. F., Tuijtel, M. W., Voortman, L. M., Sharp, T. H. (2023). Selecting optimal support grids for super-resolution cryogenic correlated light and electron microscopy. Scientific Reports 13, 8270.

Berkamp, S., Daviran, D., Smeets, M., Caignard, A., Jani, R. A., Sundermeyer, P., Jonker, C., Gerlach, S., Hoffmann, B., Lau, K., Sachse, C. (2023). Correlative Light and Electron Cryo-Microscopy Workflow Combining Micropatterning, Ice Shield, and an In-Chamber Fluorescence Light Microscope. Bio-protocol 13(24), e4901.
Huebinger, J., Bastiaens, P. I. H. (2026). Determination of factors that allow cryogenic nanoscopy with high power illumination without devitrification. PLoS One 21(3), e0344631.

reported_conditions.as_printed: − 183 °C (liquid ethane); Leica EM GP at 12 °C, 50% humidity
all tools fully cooled to liquid nitrogen temperatures

requirements.rationale: Last et al. (2023) state that devitrification occurs when vitrified samples are heated above approximately 136 K; Huebinger & Bastiaens (2026) state that heating above the glass transition devitrifies the sample. Staying below this temperature is therefore a stated physical necessity for vitrified specimens, not merely the papers' choice. The sources themselves hold the stage at 77 K.
Fluorescence imaging of the cold specimen requires an optical path to the sample; Last et al. image through a 0.9 NA air objective on a Linkam CMS196v3 cryo-stage.

missing_information: EM grid diameter not stated (3 mm never given explicitly in either source); grids described only by mesh and film type
cryo-stage window material and clear aperture not stated
sample thermal load tolerated at 77 K stated only as illumination power densities (16–254 W/cm2 depending on grid film), not as a cooling-power figure
humidity requirement during imaging/transfer not stated (only plunge-freezer chamber humidity is given)
confirmation_note: Requirements reviewed and confirmed by the profile author on 2026-10-31 against the quoted evidence records. Any edited value must be re-confirmed by the user before the profile is used.
